Chininum Salicylicum.

Salicylate of Quinine. (C20H24N2O2)2 C7H4O3. Trituration and solution.

Clinical.─Deafness. Meničre's disease. Tinnitus.

Characteristics.─"Of all the preparations of Quinine the Salicylate is the most injurious to the structures of the internal ear" (Cozzolino); and, therefore, in all likelihood, the most powerful homśopathic curative. It is unproved.
